Charter Bus Phoenix: Complete Guide for Large Group Transportation

Moving 30, 50, or even 100+ people requires serious logistics. Charter buses offer the most efficient solution for large group transportation in Phoenix and throughout Arizona.

When to Use a Charter Bus

  • Corporate conferences and team events
  • School field trips and sports teams
  • Wedding guest shuttles
  • Church groups and ministry outings
  • Family reunions and milestone celebrations
  • Casino trips and group entertainment

Charter Bus Types

56-Passenger Motorcoach (56 passengers)

The gold standard for large groups

  • Reclining seats with footrests
  • Overhead storage
  • Onboard restroom
  • WiFi and charging outlets
  • Climate control zones
  • DVD/entertainment system

Best for: Long distances, corporate travel, full-day events

Mini Bus and Executive Mini Coaches (24, 27 or 29 passengers)

The versatile middle option

  • High-back cushioned seats
  • Overhead storage
  • Optional restroom
  • Climate control
  • PA system

Best for: Airport shuttles, local events, medium groups

Long Distance

Day trips are booked by the hour at the same rates: the 56-Passenger Motorcoach is $325 an hour with a 5-hour minimum, and 7+ hours earns 1 free hour, 12+ earns 2. A one-way run is priced as a transfer, flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included. Prices are before 8% Arizona sales tax. Every rate is on the pricing page.

Planning Your Charter

Information Needed

  1. Date and times (departure/return)
  2. Pickup and drop-off locations
  3. Total passenger count
  4. Any stops along the way
  5. Special requirements (accessibility, WiFi)
  6. Point of contact on day of

Booking Timeline

  • 6+ months ahead: Major events, peak season
  • 3-6 months ahead: Weddings, conferences
  • 1-3 months ahead: Standard bookings
  • 2-4 weeks ahead: Possible but limited options
